name: Immortality
overview: Scripture reveals a clear distinction between the immortality of God and the mortality of man. While God is exalted forever and ever, worthy of eternal praise, human beings are described as fragile and perishable, formed from dust and destined to perish without regard (Job 4:17-20; Nehemiah 9:5). The example of Enoch, who walked with God and was taken by Him rather than experiencing death, points to the divine power over life and death (Genesis 5:24). These passages underscore that immortality is not inherent to mankind but is granted by God alone.
